episodes.155272: A surface front stalled near Kauai, along with an upper trough, brought heavy rain and thunderstorms to parts of the Aloha State, and flash flooding to Kauai.  Downpours over windward East Maui during this episode contributed to the death of a 26-year-old woman who was swept out to sea when Waioka Pond near Hana became swollen by waters coming down the slope from near the Haleakala summit.  The costs of any damages were not available.
episodes.155794: A closed low and associated trough moved across the area in the afternoon bringing increased low level instability.
episodes.156427: Isolated gale-force wind gusts occurred as a weakening squall line along the leading edge of a cold front pushed through the lower Florida Keys.

events.narrative: A wind gust of 36 knots was measured at the new Sand Key Light.

Kuhio Highway was closed near the Hanalei Bridge due to flooding from the Hanalei River. Also, a debris flow occurred near Lumahai that partially closed Kuhio Highway in the area, and Wailua Marina was inundated by flood waters.
